notes.general_comments:
1822 candidates took this 30 question multiple-choice examination and the mean score was 22.6 which is
very close to the mean score last year of 22.7.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 14, 15, 16, 18, 22,
23, 24, 26 and 27. These questions were answered correctly by 80% or more of the candidates. They
covered different parts of the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were Questions 13 and 20.
